title: 第五 章 二叔的提醒第 六章 青云坊市
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
无奈之下，陆行舟收拾好心情，将溯源鼎安置在一个极为不起眼的角落。
随后又投身到枯燥的苦修生活之中。
毕竟他肩负着坐镇玲珑阁的任务，哪里都不能去。
关于那些想法，只能暂且搁置，等以后再说。
自从陆峰出现后，家族给予陆行舟的待遇便发生了变化。
原本每月能得到三块灵石和两斤灵米，如今已和其他家族子弟一样。
陆行舟对此早有心理准备。
他深知家族修炼资源有限，换做任何人处在家主的位置，都会做出这样的决定，所以他并未心生埋怨。
好在陆引弘偶尔还会悄悄送些资源给他，这才让他的修为不至于停滞不前。
时光匆匆，两年多的时间一晃而过。
陆行舟修为不仅顺利突破到了炼气五层。
就连陆引媛给他的那本记载着数千种常见灵药的玉简，也被他钻研得透彻无比。
这一日，陆行舟结束闭关，离开密室，来到会客厅。
只见一位二十多岁的青衣女子正悠然自得的坐在那里喝茶。
女子五官清秀，气质温婉，此人不是别人，正是“行”字辈的老大——陆行雨。
“大姐，你怎么会在这儿？”陆行舟满脸疑惑地问道。
“咦！小弟，你都炼气五层啦？”
陆行雨微微挑眉，眼中闪过一丝惊讶。
紧接着她话锋一转，似笑非笑地说道，“怎么？你还想继续留在这儿？那我去和族长说说。”
“额，大姐，你就别打趣小弟我了。”

“我只是觉得挺意外的，你不是一直在坊市中坐镇吗？”
“是三叔和族长提议，让家族中的后辈都去各个地方历练一番，说是这样能提升后辈的发展空间，增长见识。”陆行雨缓缓说道。
听到是三叔的提议，陆行舟心中便不再觉得意外了。
他眼珠一转，一脸八卦地问道：“大姐，族长之前不是说要为你物色道侣嘛？怎么样，有结果了没？”
陆行雨并未回答他这个问题，只是催促他赶紧去找长老交接任务。
陆行舟见状，也不再继续追问，和她寒暄了几句，这才转身离开。
陆家的情况颇为尴尬，族中修士数量本就不多，为了家族的延续，家族女修都不会外嫁。
可其他家族嫌弃陆家太过贫穷，不愿将子弟嫁入。
至于散修，修为高的，陆家担心对方会图谋家族大权，取而代之。
修为低的，陆家又瞧不上。
如此一来，陆家的女修大多只能孤独终老。
陆行舟收拾好随身物品，又特意用布袋将溯源鼎包裹好，系在腰间。
这才放心地离开玲珑阁，朝着山顶的方向走去。
山顶的一座府邸中，一位白发苍苍的老者正紧皱眉头，盯着一本破旧的账本，满脸愁容。
他轻轻叹了口气，放下账本，不经意间抬眼，便见陆行舟正朝着这边走来。
“二叔，我过来交接任务。”
陆行舟来到老者面前，恭敬地弯腰行礼说道。
这位老者便是陆家大长老陆引齐，他负责掌管任务阁以及修仙资源的调控。
content_en:
In desperation, Lu Xingzhou gathered his mood and placed the traceability tripod in an extremely inconspicuous corner.
Then he devoted himself to the boring life of asceticism.
After all, he shoulders the task of guarding Linglong Pavilion and cannot go anywhere.
Regarding those ideas, we can only put them aside for the time being and talk about them later.
Since Lu Feng appeared, the treatment given to Lu Xingzhou by the family has changed.
Originally, he could get three spiritual stones and two kilograms of spiritual rice every month, but now he is the same as other family members.
Lu Xingzhou had been mentally prepared for this.
He knew that the family's cultivation resources were limited, and anyone in the position of the head of the family would make such a decision, so he did not complain.
Fortunately, Lu Yinhong would occasionally send him some resources secretly, so that his cultivation would not stagnate.
Time flies, and more than two years have passed by.
Lu Xingzhou's cultivation not only successfully broke through to the fifth level of Qi refining.
Even the jade slip that Lu Yinyuan gave him, which recorded thousands of common elixirs, was studied thoroughly by him.
On this day, Lu Xingzhou ended his retreat, left the secret room, and came to the living room.
I saw a woman in Tsing Yi in her twenties sitting there leisurely drinking tea.
The woman has delicate features and a gentle temperament. This person is none other than Lu Xingyu, the boss of the "Xing" generation.
"Sister, why are you here?" Lu Xingzhou asked with confusion on his face.
"Hey! Little brother, are you at the fifth level of Qi refining?"
Lu Xingyu raised his eyebrows slightly, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
Then she changed the subject and said with a half-smile, "What? You still want to stay here? Then I'll go talk to the clan leader."
"Um, eldest sister, please stop teasing me."
"I just find it quite surprising. Haven't you always been in charge of the city?"
"It was the third uncle and the clan leader who suggested that the younger generations in the family go to various places to experience, saying that this would improve the younger generations' development space and increase their knowledge." Lu Xingyu said slowly.
When Lu Xingzhou heard that it was his third uncle who made the suggestion, he was no longer surprised.
He rolled his eyes and asked with a gossipy face: "Sister, didn't the clan leader say before that he wanted to find a Taoist companion for you? How is it? Is there any result?"
Lu Xingyu did not answer his question, but urged him to go to the elder to hand over the task.
When Lu Xingzhou saw this, he stopped asking questions and exchanged a few words with her before turning around and leaving.
The situation of the Lu family is quite embarrassing. There are not many monks in the family. For the sake of the continuation of the family, the female monks in the family will not marry outside.
But other families disliked the Lu family for being too poor and were unwilling to marry their children into it.
As for the casual cultivators, those with high cultivation levels, the Lu family is worried that the other party will seek family power and replace them.
Those with low cultivation level are looked down upon by the Lu family.
As a result, most of the female nuns in the Lu family could only die alone.
Lu Xingzhou packed his belongings and specially wrapped the traceability cauldron in a cloth bag and tied it around his waist.
Then he left Linglong Pavilion with confidence and walked towards the top of the mountain.
In a mansion on the top of the mountain, a white-haired old man was frowning, staring at an old account book with a sad look on his face.
He sighed softly, put down his account book, and inadvertently raised his eyes to see Lu Xingzhou walking towards this side.
"Second uncle, I'm here to hand over the task."
Lu Xingzhou came to the old man, bowed respectfully and said.
This old man is Lu Yinqi, the eldest elder of the Lu family. He is responsible for the task pavilion and the control of immortal cultivation resources.
